The LV era turns pressure into electricity. Machine hulls, good circuits, electric macerators — and the first rule of GT law: §cvoltage discipline§r.

The tutorial's Safety First canon, abbreviated: machines left in the rain start fires; fires next to machines roll dice with explosions; feeding a machine higher voltage than its tier detonates it; excess amps are harmless but overpowered cables melt and burn everything nearby.

This segment also introduces the MIAO way of wiring: GTSWN link covers, no cables at all.
